heroHeadline: BRICS Working Groups Advance India's 2026 Chairmanship Agenda Ahead of FM Meeting
heroSubtitle: Under India's 2026 BRICS presidency ('Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'), labor cooperation and MSME finance frameworks are taking shape across working group meetings in Thiruvananthapuram and virtual sessions. The BRICS Foreign Ministers convene in New Delhi on May 14–15 to set the final agenda for the 18th BRICS Summit (September 12–13, New Delhi). BRICS now stands at 10 full members representing ~41% of world GDP (PPP) and ~46% of global population.
footerNote: Data sourced from official BRICS declarations, NDB annual reports, IMF, and major international outlets. Source tiers reflect editorial confidence levels.
